text: dsh-api 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地 HTTP 接口插件：它接入 DSH 的 ApiProxy，并在本机提供带 bearer token 认证的服务。其他 agent 可以通过接口列出和创建会话、读取历史、发送提示、取消运行中的回合，并接收按会话筛选的 SSE 事件；未封装的 API 路径也可转发到官方 ApiProxy。适合需要从自动化程序控制 DSH 会话的场景。使用前在设置页启用服务并配置 token，默认监听 127.0.0.1:4777。

dsh-api exposes a local HTTP API for DSH. Other agents can list or create sessions, read history, send prompts, cancel turns, and stream session events through the official ApiProxy. Enable it in settings and use a bearer token; the server listens on 127.0.0.1:4777 by default.
我想让另一个 agent 通过 HTTP 查看和管理 DSH 会话。
能不能从程序里读取某个会话的历史记录？
希望自动化脚本能创建会话并提交提示。
DSH 正在运行的回合可以从外部接口取消吗？
I need an HTTP endpoint to stream events for one DSH session.
How can another agent send prompts to my local DSH instance?
dsh-api 的功能「会话管理」：通过 HTTP 列出、创建 DSH 会话。客户端对 /api/sessions 发 GET 或 POST，返回 ApiProxy 的操作结果。
dsh-api 的功能「历史与提示」：按会话 ID 读取历史记录，或向指定会话发送提示；提示模式默认 queue。
dsh-api 的功能「取消回合」：对会话的 cancel 路由发起 POST，即可调用 DSH 会话取消接口并返回操作结果。
dsh-api 的功能「会话事件流」：GET 会话的 stream 路由会提供 SSE，将匹配该会话 ID 的事件帧逐条发送给客户端。
dsh-api 会在本机 127.0.0.1 启动 HTTP 服务，除 /health 外的路由要求 bearer token；默认端口为 4777，token 未设置有效值时自动生成。
想从外部工具列出当前的 DSH 会话。
I want to cancel a running DSH turn using an API call.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · dsh-api：Local HTTP API for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Other AI agents use it to control
DSH through plain HTTP instead of the GUI.

Milestone one covers session control: list and create sessions, read history,
send prompts, stream replies, and cancel turns. Everything else remains
available through the raw `/api/*` passthrough.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Install：Install the plugin into a DSH web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-api
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin` registers it in the
profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically. No manual cordis patch is
needed. Once published, install from the registry with
`dsh plugin --profile web add @kelemiao/dsh-api`.

Settings live in the GUI Settings page under `dsh-api` and apply immediately.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Settings：| Field   | Type   | Default               | Notes                  |
|---------|--------|-----------------------|------------------------|
| enabled | bool   | true                  | server on/off          |
| port    | int    | 4777                  | 1-65535, loopback only |
| token   | secret | generated on first run | fixed bearer token     |

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Endpoints：| Method | Path                      | Purpose                                        |
|--------|---------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| GET    | `/health`                 | Public health check.                           |
| GET    | `/api/sessions`           | List sessions: `{ items: SessionSummary[] }`.  |
| POST   | `/api/sessions`           | Create session; body `{ cwd?, workspaceId?, agentPreset? }`. |
| GET    | `/api/sessions/:id/history` | Read history; query `beforeSeq?`, `maxMessages?`. |
| POST   | `/api/sessions/:id/prompt` | Send prompt; body `{ content, mode? }`.        |
| POST   | `/api/sessions/:id/cancel` | Cancel the running turn.                       |
| GET    | `/api/sessions/:id/stream` | SSE stream filtered to this session.           |
| POST   | `/api/*`                  | Raw official ApiProxy JSON RPC passthrough.    |
| GET    | `/api/events.mux`         | Raw official aggregated SSE stream.            |

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Endpoints：Convenience routes win over the passthrough; any other request whose path
starts with `/api/` is forwarded verbatim to the official ApiProxy transport.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Authentication：All routes except `/health` require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The
server binds `127.0.0.1` only. Missing or wrong tokens get `401`.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · SSE：```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $DSH_API_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:4777/api/sessions/<sessionId>/stream
```

Frames are official MuxFrame objects, filtered by session id. A prompt whose
single text block starts with `/` runs as a slash command, like the GUI.

@kelemiao/dsh-api README · Smoke test：With the plugin enabled in a running DSH:

```bash
DSH_API_TOKEN=<token> node scripts/smoke.mjs
```

`DSH_API_URL` defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:4777`.
